module.purpose: Provides authentication email verification workflows, including feature gating, watchlist blocking, rate limiting, token persistence, time-based code generation, localization, and delivery of verification messages.
module.summary: This module supports verification of primary, secondary, and changed email addresses. It generates expiring database-backed tokens for link verification, derives time-based verification codes for code-based verification, applies feature and abuse-prevention checks, and delegates localized email delivery to the email manager. Platform-specific requests can bypass link delivery, while blocked addresses are refused.
module.businessContext:
Supports account security and email ownership confirmation in the authentication system.
Failures can prevent sign-up, email changes, or secondary-address verification, while bypassing controls could enable abuse.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Email verification is globally disabled when a verification email is requested.
moduleContractTests.then: resolves to { ok: true, skipped: true } and does not create a verification token or send an email

moduleContractTests.scenario: The requested email is present on the watchlist.
moduleContractTests.then: resolves to { ok: false, skipped: false } and does not send an email
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures blocked addresses cannot receive verification messages.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Email verification is requested for a platform user.
moduleContractTests.when: sendEmailVerification({ email, language, username, isPlatform: true })
moduleContractTests.then: resolves to { ok: true, skipped: true } and does not create a verification token or send an email

moduleContractTests.scenario: A normal email verification request passes feature, watchlist, and rate-limit checks.
moduleContractTests.then: creates verificationToken with a random token, the email identifier, an expiry 24 hours ahead, and secondaryEmailId || null
moduleContractTests.rationale: Protects token persistence and expiry semantics.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An unblocked email requests code-based verification.
moduleContractTests.then: sends a verification code generated from md5(email + process.env.CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY) with a 900-second TOTP step and resolves to { ok: true, skipped: false }
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins deterministic secret derivation and code lifetime.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A change-of-email request passes feature, watchlist, and rate-limit checks.
moduleContractTests.then: sends a link at `${WEBAPP_URL}/auth/verify-email-change?${params.toString()}` containing the generated token and both email addresses
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the change-email route and payload mapping.
